title: File:The Talatal Ghar.jpg
author: Aateesh Bangia
description: The remains of Talatal Ghar, a palace which was initially built as an army base. It houses two secret tunnels, and three floors below ground level which were used as exit routes during the Ahom wars (and which give the structure its name). Situated in Shivsagar,Assam
period_note: Surviving masonry predominantly 18th century; not direct evidence for a 15th-century palace
classification_note: Classified from source title/category; not a full visual authentication.
classification_method: source metadata and user reference taxonomy; no full per-image visual audit
patronage_context: Ahom-period context where identified; patronage does not determine architectural tradition
